title: Backup Directory
description: Create a compressed timestamped backup of a directory.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

SOURCE="${1:-$HOME/data}"
BACKUP_DIR="${BACKUP_DIR:-$HOME/backups}"

if [[ ! -d "$SOURCE" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Source directory not found: $SOURCE" >&2
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

NAME=$(basename "$SOURCE")
ARCHIVE="$BACKUP_DIR/${NAME}-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE" -C "$(dirname "$SOURCE")" "$NAME"

echo "Backup created: $ARCHIVE"
